headline: Python f-strings
sub: print(f"{name} scored {marks}%") — cleaner than + or .format(). Embed any variable in {}.
subject: Coding

headline: List Slicing
sub: nums = [1,2,3,4,5]; print(nums[1:3]) → [2,3]. Also: nums[::2] gives every 2nd element.
subject: Coding

headline: List Comprehension
sub: squares = [x**2 for x in range(5)] → [0,1,4,9,16]. Much faster than a loop!
subject: Coding

headline: Dictionary .get()
sub: d = {'name': 'Raj'}; print(d.get('age', 'Not found')) — returns default, never errors.
subject: Coding

headline: Set Removes Duplicates
sub: nums = [1,2,2,3,3]; unique = set(nums) → {1,2,3}. Fast and clean!
subject: Coding

headline: For-Else in Python
sub: for i in range(5): ... else: print('Done!') — else runs if loop completes without break.
subject: Coding

headline: zip() Function
sub: names = ['A','B']; ages = [18,19]; for n,a in zip(names,ages): print(n,a) — pairs them up.
subject: Coding

headline: String .split()
sub: s = 'Hello World'; words = s.split() → ['Hello','World']. Default splits on spaces.
subject: Coding

headline: Truth Value Testing
sub: if items: checks if list is non-empty. if not items: checks if empty. Pythonic!
subject: Coding

headline: Multiple Assignment
sub: a, b = 1, 2 — swap: a, b = b, a. Or unpack: x, y, *rest = [1,2,3,4,5].
subject: Coding

headline: enumerate()
sub: for i, item in enumerate(['a','b','c']): → i=0,1,2 and item='a','b','c'. Get both index+value.
subject: Coding

headline: Lambda Functions
sub: square = lambda x: x**2; print(square(5)) → 25. Quick anonymous function. Use wisely!
subject: Coding

headline: map() Function
sub: nums = [1,2,3]; doubled = list(map(lambda x: x*2, nums)) → [2,4,6]. Applies function to all.
subject: Coding

headline: filter() Function
sub: nums = [1,2,3,4]; evens = list(filter(lambda x: x%2==0, nums)) → [2,4].
subject: Coding

headline: Type Hints in Python
sub: def greet(name: str) -> str: return f'Hi {name}' — documents what types to pass.
subject: Coding

headline: Try-Except-Finally
sub: try: x = int(input()); except ValueError: print('Not a number'); finally: print('Done')
subject: Coding

headline: While Loop vs For
sub: while count < 5: (unknown count) vs for i in range(5): (known count). Pick the right one!
subject: Coding

headline: String Formatting %
sub: name = 'Priya'; print('Hi %s' % name) — old style, but still used. Use f-strings instead!
subject: Coding

headline: in vs not in
sub: if 'a' in 'apple': print('yes') — checks substring. if 5 not in [1,2,3]: print('missing')
subject: Coding

headline: Count Method
sub: s = 'banana'; print(s.count('a')) → 3. Works on strings AND lists!
subject: Coding

headline: Sorting Lists
sub: nums = [3,1,4]; nums.sort() — sorts in-place. sorted(nums) returns new list.
subject: Coding

headline: HTML: Basic Structure
sub: <!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Page</title></head><body>Content</body></html>
subject: Coding

headline: CSS: Box Model
sub: .box { margin: 10px; border: 1px solid; padding: 20px; } — outside-to-inside.
subject: Coding

headline: JavaScript: Fetch API
sub: fetch('/api/data').then(r => r.json()).then(d => console.log(d)) — get data from server.
subject: Coding

headline: SQL: SELECT
sub: SELECT name, age FROM students WHERE age > 18 ORDER BY name; — filter and sort.
subject: Coding

headline: SQL: INSERT
sub: INSERT INTO students (name, age) VALUES ('Arjun', 19); — add new row. Always check constraints!
subject: Coding

headline: SQL: JOIN
sub: SELECT s.name, c.course FROM students s JOIN courses c ON s.id = c.student_id;
subject: Coding

headline: Common Python Mistake
sub: WRONG: x = [1,2,3]; y = x; y.append(4) → BOTH changed! USE: y = x.copy()
subject: Coding
